scope.statement: A local geometric full-shore extension countermodel: the unique saturating full-shore matchings can induce restricted image overlap larger than the combined Hall defect on the restricted shores.
scope.domain: Exact rational squared-distance and matching enumeration on six named points; no search or floating point. The second target shore is a pair in the standard unit triangular lattice.
scope.limitations: Does not satisfy or establish the Section-168 fixed-hull global-capacity, plateau-endpoint, complete Y_in, or collar hypotheses; no Schur conclusion.

result: Exact finite regression with restricted Hall defect 0 and inherited full-shore image overlap 1.
remaining_questions: Determine whether actual Section-168 global source-capacity and plateau-collar hypotheses force overlap above the PR-102 Hall lower bound or admit a matching geometric counterexample.
